```python
def test_the_schedule_off_for_24_hours_after_the_catch_up_needs_attention(plaud_scene):
    # C6.14. Off before the catch-up is plain; after it, once off for 24 hours, Needs attention.
    s = plaud_scene
    s.schedule_minutes = 0
    before = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)
    assert before["summary"]["sentence"] == "Scheduled sync is off"
    assert "Scheduled sync is off." not in before["conditions"]  # the summary says it (P12)
    assert not [a for a in before["attention"] if a.startswith("Scheduled sync")]
    done = T0 - timedelta(hours=30)
    s.open_gate(at=done)
    early = sync_panel(s.settings, now=done + timedelta(hours=23))
    assert "Scheduled sync is off since 2026-10-22 08:20." in early["conditions"]
    assert not [a for a in early["attention"] if a.startswith("Scheduled sync")]
    late = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)
    assert [a for a in late["attention"] if a.startswith("Scheduled sync")] == [
        (
            "Scheduled sync has been off since 2026-10-22 08:20: set [plaud] schedule_minutes to "
            "turn it back on, or pause the sync's Healthchecks check (runbook)."
        )
    ]


def test_each_needs_attention_entry_phase_1_can_show(plaud_scene):
    s = plaud_scene
    s.schedule_minutes = 0
    s.open_gate(at=T0 - timedelta(hours=30))
    db = s.db
    # What the worker read, as Task 13 writes it: the count, never the IDs.
    consent = {"count": 3, "stop": typo_phrase([14, 22]), "read_at": T0.isoformat()}
    db.put(K_CONSENT, consent, now=T0)
    open_blocker(db, "consent", now=T0 - timedelta(minutes=5))
    a, b, c = s.add(11, "Week 11"), s.add(12, "Week 12"), s.add(13, "Week 13")
    db.add_event("consent-late", now=T0, recording_id=a, plaud_id=s.plaud_id(11), open_flag=True)
    s.kept_out_late(12)
    db.add_event("private-unwritten", now=T0, recording_id=c, open_flag=True)
    beat = T0 - timedelta(minutes=10)
    heartbeat_once(s.writer.state, Progress(phase="idle", counter=1, at=beat), now=beat)
    failed_since = T0 - timedelta(hours=2, minutes=1)
    db.put(
        K_LAST_PING,
        {
            "at": (T0 - timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat(),
            "ok": False,
            "status": 404,
            "failed_since": failed_since.isoformat(),
        },
        now=T0,
    )
    with plaud_run(s.writer.state, "plaud-sync", timeout=1.0, now=T0 - timedelta(hours=3)):
        attention = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)["attention"]
    for line in (
        (
            "Plaud imports stopped: the consent list has 2 lines that look like IDs but can't be "
            "read (lines 14 and 22)."
        ),
        f"Recording {a} is on the consent list, but in the archive. Take it out by hand (runbook).",
        (
            f"Recording {b} was kept out by title after it came in. Take it out by hand (runbook), "
            "or Keep it here."
        ),
        (
            f"Recording {c} should be private, but its file was edited outside the app: run "
            "`recordings reindex`."
        ),
        (
            "The Plaud worker is silent (last reported 14:10): check that the worker container is "
            "running."
        ),
        "A sync has run since 11:20: it may be stuck.",
        PING_FAILING,
    ):
        assert line in attention, line
    assert [x for x in attention if x.startswith("Scheduled sync has been off since")]
    assert sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)["numbers"]["consent"]["ids"] == 3
    # Sync everything may hold the lock for 12 hours before it may be stuck.
    with plaud_run(s.writer.state, "plaud-full", timeout=1.0, now=T0 - timedelta(hours=3)):
        attention = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)["attention"]
    assert not [x for x in attention if x.endswith("it may be stuck.")]


def test_the_worker_line_is_in_plain_words_and_a_failed_start_says_so(plaud_scene):
    # why: §15.2's "last reported 14:21 (checking, …)", never the worker's own phase names; and a
    # worker whose start keeps failing never reads as alive (Task 13 writes the phase `failed`).
    s = plaud_scene
    beat = T0 - timedelta(seconds=20)
    for phase, words in (
        ("idle", "idle"),
        ("turn", "syncing"),
        ("request", "answering a request"),
        ("consent", "reading the consent list"),
    ):
        heartbeat_once(s.writer.state, Progress(phase=phase, counter=1, at=beat), now=beat)
        panel = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)
        assert panel["numbers"]["worker"] == f"last reported 14:19 ({words})", phase
    failed = {
        "at": beat.isoformat(),
        "phase": "failed",
        "error": "OSError",
        "progress_counter": 0,
        "progress_at": beat.isoformat(),
    }
    s.writer.state.set_meta(HEARTBEAT_KEY, json.dumps(failed))
    panel = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)
    assert panel["numbers"]["worker"] == "last reported 14:19 (couldn't start: `OSError`)"
    assert (
        "The Plaud worker couldn't start (`OSError`): see `rc logs worker` (runbook)."
        in panel["attention"]
    )
    # A class name only: anything else there shows as no particular class (§15.6).
    s.writer.state.set_meta(HEARTBEAT_KEY, json.dumps({**failed, "error": "no such file /x"}))
    assert "(couldn't start: `Exception`)" in sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)["numbers"]["worker"]


def test_the_patterns_pass_at_start_shows_how_far_it_has_checked(plaud_scene):
    # why: §15.2's "The Plaud worker last reported 14:21 (checking, 412 of 1,234)". Task 13 runs
    # the patterns pass as `checking`, its heartbeat carrying `done` and `total`.
    s = plaud_scene
    beat = T0 - timedelta(seconds=20)
    checking = {
        "at": beat.isoformat(),
        "phase": "checking",
        "done": 412,
        "total": 1234,
        "progress_counter": 412,
        "progress_at": beat.isoformat(),
    }
    s.writer.state.set_meta(HEARTBEAT_KEY, json.dumps(checking))
    worker = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)["numbers"]["worker"]
    assert worker == "last reported 14:19 (checking, 412 of 1,234)"
    s.writer.state.set_meta(HEARTBEAT_KEY, json.dumps({**checking, "total": None}))
    assert sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)["numbers"]["worker"] == "last reported 14:19 (checking)"


def test_a_late_consent_pass_that_failed_names_its_class_and_a_remedy_that_helps(plaud_scene):
    # why: a whole late consent pass that failed (a full or read-only disk, a busy state.db) can't
    # be mended by `recordings reindex`: Task 13's blocker carries the class, and the summary and
    # Needs attention say it, with the remedy that helps.
    s = plaud_scene
    stopped = (
        "Late consent listings stopped (OSError): check the archive disk, then the worker's log."
    )
    open_blocker(s.db, "private-unwritten", now=T0, detail={"error": "OSError"})
    panel = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)
    assert panel["summary"]["sentence"] == stopped.removesuffix(".")
    assert stopped in panel["attention"]
    assert sync_view(s.settings, now=T0, can_request=None)["summary"] == panel["summary"]
    # With no error (a flag is open), the summary stays the blocker's own line.
    open_blocker(s.db, "private-unwritten", now=T0, detail={})
    panel = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)
    assert panel["summary"]["sentence"] == "Should be private: run `recordings reindex`"
    assert not [a for a in panel["attention"] if a.startswith("Late consent listings stopped")]


def test_an_unwritten_flag_says_what_its_cause_needs(plaud_scene):
    # why: `recordings reindex` mends a file edited outside the app (StaleFile, InvalidFile), not
    # a disk or permissions fault: Task 8 records each flag's cause, and the sentences follow it.
    s = plaud_scene
    io, edited = s.add(31, "Week 31"), s.add(32, "Week 32")
    s.db.add_event(
        "private-unwritten",
        now=T0,
        recording_id=io,
        detail={"owed": "consent", "cause": "OSError"},
        open_flag=True,
    )
    s.db.add_event(
        "private-unwritten",
        now=T0,
        recording_id=edited,
        detail={"owed": "consent", "cause": "StaleFile"},
        open_flag=True,
    )
    rows = {
        f["recording_id"]: f["sentence"]
        for f in sync_view(s.settings, now=T0, can_request=None)["flags"]
    }
    assert rows[io] == (
        f"Recording {io} should be private, but its file couldn't be written (OSError): check the "
        "archive disk and its permissions."
    )
    assert rows[edited] == SENTENCES["private-unwritten"]
    attention = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)["attention"]
    assert rows[io] in attention  # Task 8's sentence names the recording itself
    assert (
        f"Recording {edited} should be private, but its file was edited outside the app: run "
        "`recordings reindex`."
    ) in attention
    assert recording_plaud(s.settings, io, now=T0)["flags"][0]["sentence"] == rows[io]

def test_what_a_later_phase_writes_stays_empty_in_phase_1(plaud_scene):
    # Phase 1 reads its own data only: each section a later phase fills keeps its empty value
    # until that phase brings its reader, and the screens draw it empty.
    s = plaud_scene
    s.open_gate()
    s.db.put(K_KEEP_OUT_WORDS, ["noarchive"], now=T0)
    view = sync_view(s.settings, now=T0, can_request=None)
    assert [view[k] for k in ("equation", "archive", "hold", "breaker", "titles_hidden")] == [
        None
    ] * 5
    assert [view["not_here"], view["kept_out"], view["parked"], view["gone"]["rows"]] == [[]] * 4
    assert view["full_estimate"] == FULL_UNKNOWN
    assert view["import_all"] == {"count": 0, "review_more": 0}
    panel = sync_panel(s.settings, now=T0)
    numbers, details = panel["numbers"], panel["details"]
    later = ("equation", "archive", "last_good_listing", "sweep", "sign_in", "full")
    assert [numbers[k] for k in later] == [None] * len(later)
    assert [numbers[k] for k in ("held", "gone", "failing", "parked")] == [0] * 4
    assert (details["runs"], details["census"], details["fields"]) == ([], {}, [])
    assert details["keep_out_words"] == ["noarchive"]  # Task 10 records the words enforced


def test_the_demo_view_is_the_hand_written_fixture_with_the_demo_notes(tmp_path):
    raw = json.loads(DEMO_FIXTURE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    view = demo_view(DEMO_FIXTURE)
    sync, panel = view["sync"], view["panel"]
    # Every key is written, and none is misspelt.
    assert set(raw["sync"]) == set(sync) and set(raw["panel"]) == set(panel)
    assert (sync["demo"], sync["available"], sync["reason"]) == (True, False, DEMO_NOTE)
    assert sync["summary"]["kind"] == "demo" and sync["summary"]["sentence"] == DEMO_NOTE
    assert set(sync["buttons"].values()) == {DEMO_NOTE}
    assert (sync["handled"], sync["not_yet"], sync["gate"]) == (["keep-here"], NOT_YET, None)
    assert sync["listed"] is True and panel["listed"] is True  # the demo shows every part
    assert sync["not_here"] == [{**row, "park": False} for row in raw["sync"]["not_here"]]
    assert not [r for r in sync["kept_out"] if r["release"]]
    assert not [f for f in sync["flags"] if f["keep_here"]]
    assert panel["summary"]["sentence"] == DEMO_STATUS and panel["attention"] == []
    assert view["arrivals"] == raw["arrivals"]
    # Hand-written and synthetic: every Plaud ID is a small counter.
    ids = re.findall(r"of_[0-9a-f]+", DEMO_FIXTURE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert ids and all(re.fullmatch(r"of_0{24}[0-9a-f]{8}", i) for i in ids)
    # Demo mode copies it beside the archive's copy, where the views read it (decision 23).
    canned = demo_view_settings(from_env({}, demo=True).archive)
    assert canned.demo_view.read_bytes() == DEMO_FIXTURE.read_bytes()
    assert sync_view(canned, now=T0, can_request="any reason") == sync
    assert sync_panel(canned, now=T0) == panel
    assert arrivals(canned, since=T0, now=T0) == view["arrivals"]
    assert recording_plaud(canned, "19620912T100000-0500_229ce3ea", now=T0) is None
    assert status_view(tmp_path, None, now=T0, plaud=canned)["sync"] == panel
    # A missing file is an empty canned view, never an error: the demo still starts.
    empty = demo_view(tmp_path / "missing.json")
    assert empty["sync"]["not_here"] == [] and empty["sync"]["buttons"]["compare"] == DEMO_NOTE


def test_the_details_lines(plaud_scene):
    s = plaud_scene
    s.open_gate()
    rid = s.add(10, "Week 10", tags=(TagRef(tag="private", by="auto"),))
    db = s.db
    db.add_event(
        "retagged-private",
        now=T0 - timedelta(days=1),
        recording_id=rid,
        plaud_id=s.plaud_id(10),
        detail={"why": "title changed"},
    )
    record_late_keep_out(db, rid, [s.plaud_id(10)], "noarchive", now=T0)
    lines = recording_plaud(s.settings, rid, now=T0)
    assert lines["plaud_ids"] == [{"id": s.plaud_id(10), "copy_id": f"- `{s.plaud_id(10)}` —"}]
    # When it was checked and when next, and gone from Plaud, come with the checks (Phase 3).
    assert (lines["checked"], lines["next_by"], lines["gone_since"]) == (None, None, None)
    assert lines["tagged_private"] == (
        "Tagged private by the sync on 2026-10-22: its Plaud title changed"
    )
    assert lines["removed_private"] is None
    (flag,) = lines["flags"]
    assert flag["kind"] == "kept-out-late" and flag["keep_here"] is True
    assert lines["resync"] == "Not checked: kept out"
    assert recording_view(s.writer.archive, rid, plaud=s.settings, now=T0)["plaud"] == lines
    # Decision 3, made visible once Dan removes it; the date is the removing revision's.
    s.writer.mutate(rid, RemoveTags(("private",), may_expose=frozenset({rid})))
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(s.writer.state.db_path)) as conn, conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE revisions SET written_at = ? WHERE id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM revisions)",
            (T0.isoformat(),),
        )
    lines = recording_plaud(s.settings, rid, now=T0)
    assert lines["tagged_private"] is None
    assert lines["removed_private"] == (
        "Tagged private by the sync on 2026-10-22. You removed it on 2026-10-23. It comes back "
        "only if its Plaud title changes to a private one."
    )
    # With the gate closed, Re-sync says the gate's reason (§11.6).
    db.delete(K_CATCH_UP_DONE)
    assert recording_plaud(s.settings, rid, now=T0)["resync"] == GATE_FIRST
    # No Plaud source: no Plaud lines.
    media = s.tmp / "own.mp3"
    media.write_bytes(b"ID3 synthetic own audio")
    own = s.writer.add(
        Incoming(
            media=media,
            recorded_at=T0,
            timezone_name="UTC",
            time_source="metadata",
            title="Week 0",
            kind="audio",
            sources=(),
        )
    ).recording.id
    assert recording_plaud(s.settings, own, now=T0) is None
    assert recording_view(s.writer.archive, own, plaud=s.settings, now=T0)["plaud"] is None


def test_arrivals_count_events_since_and_flags_by_count_only(plaud_scene):
    s = plaud_scene
    db = s.db
    since = T0 - timedelta(hours=1)
    db.add_event(
        "imported", now=since - timedelta(minutes=1), recording_id="20261023T120000+0000_0000beef"
    )
    for i, kind in enumerate(
        ("imported", "imported", "arrived-private", "updated", "retagged-private")
    ):
        db.add_event(
            kind, now=T0 - timedelta(minutes=10), recording_id=f"20261023T14{i:02d}00+0000_0000beef"
        )
    a, b = s.add(21, "Week 21"), s.add(22, "Week 22")
    db.add_event("kept-out-late", now=T0, recording_id=a, plaud_id=s.plaud_id(21), open_flag=True)
    db.add_event("consent-late", now=T0, recording_id=b, plaud_id=s.plaud_id(22), open_flag=True)
    counts = arrivals(s.settings, since=since, now=T0)
    assert counts == {"new": 2, "private": 1, "updated": 2, "kept_out_late": 1, "consent_late": 1}
    assert {type(v) for v in counts.values()} == {int}  # counts only: no title, no ID
    # A Refresh moves `since`: what came before it no longer counts; the flags still do.
    assert arrivals(s.settings, since=T0, now=T0) == {**ZERO, "kept_out_late": 1, "consent_late": 1}
    assert arrivals(None, since=since, now=T0) == ZERO


def test_details_words_every_reason_the_marker_records():
    # why: decision 15 (decision 33: kept out by title). A reason Details can't word would show no
    # reason at all. Phase 1's marker records these four; Phase 2's rebuild record adds its own.
    from recordings.plaud.privacy import why_phrase

    recorded = {
        why_phrase(why) for why in ("title changed", "first check", "new pattern", "kept out late")
    }
    assert recorded == {"title changed", "first check", "patterns changed", "kept out by title"}
    assert recorded <= set(WHY_DETAILS)
    assert WHY_DETAILS[why_phrase("kept out late")] == "kept out by title"
    assert NO_SYNC == NO_SYNC_YET  # kept apart only because checks needs sqlite3


def test_the_plaud_views_import_on_pyodide_without_sqlite(demo_archive):
    # why: the Pages demo runs recordings_ui on Pyodide, which has no sqlite3 (tagging.py,
    # status.py). Its views draw only the canned view, and must not import what reads state.db.
    code = (
        "import sys; from datetime import UTC, datetime; from pathlib import Path; "
        "import recordings_ui.plaud as p; import recordings_ui.status as st; "
        f"s = p.demo_view_settings(Path({str(demo_archive)!r})); now = datetime.now(UTC); "
        "p.sync_view(s, now=now, can_request=None); p.sync_panel(s, now=now); "
        "p.arrivals(s, since=now, now=now); p.recording_plaud(s, 'x', now=now); "
        "st.status_view(Path('.'), None, plaud=s); "
        "print(sorted(m for m in ('sqlite3', 'recordings.state', 'recordings.writer', "
        "'recordings.plaud.checks') if m in sys.modules))"
    )
    out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    assert out.stdout.strip() == "[]"


def test_the_views_settings_load_no_plaud_client_even_when_read():
    # why: spec §9.1 ("It imports no client, token or sync module"), the plan's decision 31. The
    # web app reads plaud_view_settings when it starts, which calls plaud_settings: Task 4's guard
    # only sees imports, so this checks the call too.
    code = (
        "import sys\n"
        "from recordings.config import Config\n"
        "from recordings_ui.plaud import plaud_view_settings\n"
        "data = {'plaud': {'api_base': 'https://plaud.example/api', 'schedule_minutes': 5}}\n"
        "s = plaud_view_settings(Config(path=None, archive_path=None, writer_id=None,\n"
        "    default_timezone='UTC', base_url=None, data=data))\n"
        "assert s.schedule_minutes == 5, s\n"
        "print('recordings.plaud.client' in sys.modules)\n"
    )
    out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    assert out.stdout.strip() == "False"


# Calls every view against a real state.db, then submits a request that is inserted, and prints
# which of the forbidden modules (argv[4]) and of the readers they import lazily got loaded.
CALL_EVERYTHING = """
import asyncio, json, sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from recordings.archive import Archive
from recordings.state import State
from recordings_ui import plaud as p
from recordings_ui.status import StatusSettings, status_view
from recordings_ui.views import recording_view

state_path, root, rid = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
now = datetime.now(UTC)
s = p.PlaudViewSettings(state_path=state_path, timezone_name="UTC", schedule_minutes=20,
    full_sweep_days=7, auto_import=True, keep_out_word_ok=True, demo_view=None)
p.sync_view(s, now=now, can_request=None)
p.sync_panel(s, now=now)
p.arrivals(s, since=now, now=now)
assert p.recording_plaud(s, rid, now=now)["flags"]
assert recording_view(Archive(root), rid, plaud=s, now=now)["plaud"]
status = StatusSettings(state_path=state_path, timezone_name="UTC", warn=20.0, stop=5.0,
    jobs=("disk",))
assert status_view(root, status, now=now, plaud=s)["sync"]["attention"]
request = {"request_id": "probe0001test", "kind": "keep-here", "plaud_ids": [],
    "recording_ids": [rid], "all": False}
reply = asyncio.run(p.submit(State(state_path), request, now=now, timezone_name="UTC",
    reason=None))
assert reply["state"] == "queued", reply
read = ("recordings.plaud.checks", "recordings.plaud.health", "recordings.worker")
print(json.dumps({"forbidden": sorted(m for m in json.loads(sys.argv[4]) if m in sys.modules),
    "read": [m in sys.modules for m in read]}))
"""


def test_calling_the_views_and_submitting_a_request_loads_no_plaud_client(plaud_scene):
    # why: spec §9.1. The views and submit import their readers inside each call, where Task 4's
    # import guard can't see them: this calls each, against a scene, in a fresh interpreter.
    s = plaud_scene
    s.add(1, "Week 1")
    rid = s.kept_out_late(1)
    out = subprocess.run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            "-c",
            CALL_EVERYTHING,
            str(s.writer.state.path),
            str(s.writer.root),
            rid,
            json.dumps(FORBIDDEN),
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    found = json.loads(out.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    assert found == {"forbidden": [], "read": [True, True, True]}
```

```python
def test_without_the_2b_tables_it_says_no_sync_has_run_yet_never_the_restore_text(plaud_scene):
    # why: §9.5. A state.db from before 2b, or a release rolled back to, has no 2b tables. That
    # is "No sync has run yet", never a damaged state.db: restoring a sound one loses its queue.
    s = plaud_scene
    rid = s.add(1, "Week 1")
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(s.writer.state.db_path)) as conn, conn:
        for table in PLAUD_TABLES:
            conn.execute(f"DROP TABLE {table}")
    settings = _status_settings(s.writer.state.path)
    view = status_view(s.writer.root, settings, now=T0_SYNC, plaud=s.settings)
    assert view["sync"]["no_sync_yet"] is True
    assert view["sync"]["summary"]["sentence"] == NO_SYNC_YET
    assert not [line for line in view["attention"] if "restore" in line]
    assert sync_view(s.settings, now=T0_SYNC, can_request=None)["summary"]["kind"] == "no-sync"
    assert set(arrivals(s.settings, since=T0_SYNC, now=T0_SYNC).values()) == {0}
    # Details still names its Plaud ID, for `make consent-add`.
    lines = recording_plaud(s.settings, rid, now=T0_SYNC)
    assert lines["plaud_ids"] == [{"id": s.plaud_id(1), "copy_id": f"- `{s.plaud_id(1)}` —"}]
    assert lines["checked"] is None
```

```python
# ---- The views (Task 19; 2b spec §15, §22) -------------------------------------------------
# Phase 1's views read Phase 1's own data, read-only: the summary and what stops the sync
# (sync_health), the blockers, the privacy flags, what the worker read from the consent list (a
# count), the gate, the worker's heartbeat, the ping, and the requests' last result. What a later
# phase writes (the listing and its compare, holds, the breaker, checks, Sync everything, the
# sign-in's expiry, parking) is null or empty here: each reader comes with its writer, against
# types.ts and the canned view (2b phase 1 plan, Task 19). Every reader is imported inside the
# function that needs it, never at the top: the Pages demo runs this module on Pyodide, which has
# no sqlite3, and draws only the canned view (decision 23). Times and dates are formatted here, in
# the default zone; a title appears only in the Sync screen's Updated rows.

DEMO_NOTE = "Demo: nothing is synced"
DEMO_STATUS = "Demo: Plaud sync isn't part of the demo."
DEMO_VIEW_NAME = "plaud-sync.json"
NO_SYNC = (
    "No sync has run yet"  # checks.NO_SYNC_YET, kept here: checks needs sqlite3 (a test pins it)
)
NO_GOOD_LISTING = "No good listing yet"
UNREADABLE_SYNC = "The sync's records in state.db can't be read now: see Needs attention"
FULL_UNKNOWN = "unknown until the first run"
CONSENT_UNREADABLE = "the consent list can't be read"  # keepout.STOP_UNREADABLE
NO_WORKER_YET = "The Plaud worker hasn't reported yet: check that the worker container is running."
WORKER_FAILED = "The Plaud worker couldn't start (`{}`): see `rc logs worker` (runbook)."
PING_FAILING = "The sync's Healthchecks ping has failed for 2 hours."
# A late consent pass that failed as a whole (Task 13's private-unwritten blocker, with the class it
# raised): the remedy that can help, never `recordings reindex`.
UNWRITTEN_STOPPED = (
    "late consent listings stopped ({}): check the archive disk, then the worker's log"
)
# Spec §22's numbers.
PING_GRACE = timedelta(minutes=10)  # "one schedule interval plus 10 minutes"
FAILING_FOR = timedelta(hours=2)
PING_FAILING_FOR = timedelta(hours=2)
SCHEDULE_OFF_FOR = timedelta(hours=24)
STUCK_AFTER = timedelta(hours=2)
STUCK_AFTER_LONG = timedelta(hours=12)  # Sync everything and the catch-up
RECENT = timedelta(days=7)  # Updated on Plaud
FLAG_EVENTS = ("kept-out-late", "consent-late", "private-unwritten")
ARRIVAL_EVENTS = ("imported", "arrived-private", "updated", "retagged-private")
PRIVATE_EVENTS = ("retagged-private", "arrived-private")
LONG_JOBS = ("plaud-full", "plaud-catch-up")
# Decision 15: the `why` a retagged-private event records (privacy.why_phrase), as Details says it.
# Phase 2's rebuild record adds "the sync's record was rebuilt" with its wording.

    "title changed": "its Plaud title changed",
    "first check": "its title matched a private pattern",
    "patterns changed": "its title matched a private pattern",

    "listing": "no good listing",
    "disk": "the disk is too full to import",
    "work": "every fetch failed",
}
# The heartbeat's phase in plain words, for "last reported 14:21 (idle)" (§15.2).
PHASES = {
    "starting": "starting",
    "idle": "idle",
    "turn": "syncing",
    "request": "answering a request",
    "consent": "reading the consent list",
    "checking": "checking",  # the patterns pass at start, with its count (Task 13)

}

    "import": "Import selected",
    "resync": "Re-sync",

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlaudViewSettings:
    state_path: Path | None
    timezone_name: str
    schedule_minutes: int
    full_sweep_days: int
    auto_import: bool
    keep_out_word_ok: bool
    demo_view: Path | None  # demo mode and Pages: the canned view's file


def plaud_view_settings(cfg: Config) -> PlaudViewSettings:
    """For the server only: the state folder and the [plaud] keys the views read. A [plaud]
    section that won't read gives the spec's defaults here, so the app still starts; doctor and
    the worker name the fault."""
    from recordings.config import ConfigError
    from recordings.plaud.settings import (
        DEFAULT_FULL_SWEEP_DAYS,
        DEFAULT_SCHEDULE_MINUTES,
        plaud_settings,
    )

    try:
        ps = plaud_settings(cfg)
    except ConfigError:
        return PlaudViewSettings(
            state_path=cfg.state_path,
            timezone_name=cfg.default_timezone,
            schedule_minutes=DEFAULT_SCHEDULE_MINUTES,
            full_sweep_days=DEFAULT_FULL_SWEEP_DAYS,
            auto_import=True,
            keep_out_word_ok=True,
            demo_view=None,
        )
    return PlaudViewSettings(
        state_path=cfg.state_path,
        timezone_name=cfg.default_timezone,
        schedule_minutes=ps.schedule_minutes,
        full_sweep_days=ps.full_sweep_days,
        auto_import=ps.auto_import,
        keep_out_word_ok=ps.keep_out_word_ok,
        demo_view=None,
    )


def demo_view_settings(archive: Path) -> PlaudViewSettings:
    """Demo mode and Pages: no state folder, only the canned view that
    `settings.from_env(demo=True)` copied beside the archive's copy (decision 23)."""
    return PlaudViewSettings(
        state_path=None,
        timezone_name="UTC",
        schedule_minutes=0,
        full_sweep_days=7,
        auto_import=False,
        keep_out_word_ok=True,
        demo_view=archive.parent / DEMO_VIEW_NAME,
    )


def _handled() -> dict:
    """What the worker can do yet, which every view carries (G7): the UI disables every other
    request button with `not_yet` as its reason, as it shows the gate's and the demo's. Phase 1
    handles Keep it here alone; each later phase widens requests.HANDLED with its handlers."""
    return {"handled": sorted(HANDLED), "not_yet": NOT_YET}


# ---- Formatting: the server formats every time, in the default zone ----------------------------


def _local(t: datetime, tz: str) -> datetime:
    return t.astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz))


def _hm(t: datetime | None, tz: str) -> str | None:
    return None if t is None else local_hhmm(t, ZoneInfo(tz))


def _date(t: datetime | None, tz: str) -> str | None:
    return None if t is None else f"{_local(t, tz):%Y-%m-%d}"


def _stamp(t: datetime | None, tz: str) -> str | None:
    return None if t is None else f"{_date(t, tz)} {_hm(t, tz)}"


def _when(t: datetime | None, now: datetime, tz: str) -> str | None:
    """`14:20` on the same local day as now, else `2026-10-22 14:20`."""
    if t is None:
        return None
    return _hm(t, tz) if _local(t, tz).date() == _local(now, tz).date() else _stamp(t, tz)


def _copy_form(plaud_id: str) -> str:
    """Copy ID: the whole ID in the consent list's own form (§15.1), which `make consent-add`
    and the list read as an exclusion."""
    return f"- `{plaud_id}` —"


def _cap(text: str) -> str:
    return text[:1].upper() + text[1:]


def _dict(value: object) -> dict:
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _int(value: object) -> int:
    return value if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) else 0


def _class_name(value: object) -> str | None:
    """An exception's class name as the worker recorded it; anything else is none (§15.6)."""
    return value if isinstance(value, str) and value.isidentifier() else None


def _sentence(ev: Event) -> str:
    """A flag's fixed sentence (Task 8's flag_sentence): a `private` that couldn't be written for
    a reason `recordings reindex` can't mend (a full or read-only disk, a folder it can't enter, a
    busy state.db) names the recording and its cause's class, recorded in the event's detail."""
    from recordings.plaud.flags import flag_sentence

    cause = ev.detail.get("cause")
    return flag_sentence(ev.kind, ev.recording_id or "", cause if isinstance(cause, str) else None)


# ---- Reading state.db, read-only ----------------------------------------------------------------


def _open(settings: PlaudViewSettings | None) -> State | None:
    if settings is None or settings.state_path is None:
        return None
    if not (settings.state_path / "state.db").is_file():
        return None
    from recordings.state import State  # imports sqlite3: only where a state.db exists

    return State.read_only(settings.state_path)


def _q(state: State, sql: str, args: tuple = ()) -> list[tuple]:
    """A read of state.db; a 2b table that isn't there yet is NoSyncYet (§9.5), never the
    "restore state.db" text."""
    import sqlite3

    from recordings.plaud.checks import NO_SYNC_YET, NoSyncYet, no_such_table

    try:
        with state.db() as db:
            return db.execute(sql, args).fetchall()
    except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
        if no_such_table(exc):
            raise NoSyncYet(NO_SYNC_YET) from None
        raise


def _body(state: State, recording_id: str) -> dict | None:
    """The recording.json the app last committed (state.db's merge base, main spec §6.4). The
    Sync screen names a recording here from it, as the Library names it from the file."""
    from recordings.ids import ID_RE, relative_dir

    if not ID_RE.fullmatch(recording_id or ""):
        return None
    rel = (relative_dir(recording_id) / "recording.json").as_posix()
    rows = _q(
        state,
        "SELECT body FROM revisions WHERE file = ? AND committed = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",
        (rel,),
    )
    if not rows:
        return None
    try:
        body = json.loads(rows[0][0])
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return body if isinstance(body, dict) else None


def _title_here(state: State, recording_id: str) -> str | None:
    title = (_body(state, recording_id) or {}).get("title")
    return title if isinstance(title, str) else None


def _next_sync(
    settings: PlaudViewSettings, gate_open: bool, last: datetime | None, now: datetime
) -> str | None:
    """When the next scheduled turn is due: schedule_minutes after the later of last_started and
    last_ended (§9.2); none while the schedule is off or the gate closed."""
    if settings.schedule_minutes <= 0 or not gate_open or last is None:
        return None
    due = max(last + timedelta(minutes=settings.schedule_minutes), now)
    return _when(due, now, settings.timezone_name)


def _flag(db: Any, ev: Event) -> dict:
    """One privacy flag (P15), by recording ID with its next step; never a title. Its Plaud ID is
    shown as the listing row holds it (a late keep-out makes one), else in its canonical form. A
    `private` that couldn't be written says what its cause needs (_sentence)."""
    from recordings.plaud.flags import KEPT_OUT_LATE

    listed = None
    if ev.canonical_plaud_id:
        row = db.listing(ev.canonical_plaud_id)
        listed = row.listed_id if row is not None else ev.canonical_plaud_id
    return {
        "kind": ev.kind,
        "recording_id": ev.recording_id,
        "plaud_id": listed,
        "copy_id": _copy_form(listed) if listed else None,
        "sentence": _sentence(ev),
        "keep_here": ev.kind == KEPT_OUT_LATE and ev.recording_id is not None,
        "date": None,  # a possible re-keyed match's date and duration come from Phase 2's compare
        "duration": None,
    }


class _Read:
    """What one view reads, read once (spec §22). Raises NoSyncYet without the 2b tables."""

    def __init__(self, settings: PlaudViewSettings, state: State, now: datetime) -> None:
        from recordings.plaud import checks
        from recordings.plaud.gate import gate_now
        from recordings.plaud.health import sync_health

        self.settings, self.state, self.now = settings, state, now
        self.tz = settings.timezone_name
        self.db = checks.PlaudDB(state)
        self.health = sync_health(state, schedule_minutes=settings.schedule_minutes)
        self.gate = gate_now(self.db)
        get = self.db.get
        self.consent = _dict(get(checks.K_CONSENT))
        self.ping = _dict(get(checks.K_LAST_PING))
        self.words = [w for w in get(checks.K_KEEP_OUT_WORDS) or [] if isinstance(w, str)]
        stamps = (parse_stamp(get(checks.K_LAST_STARTED)), parse_stamp(get(checks.K_LAST_ENDED)))
        self.last_turn = max((t for t in stamps if t is not None and t <= now), default=None)
        self.flags = self.db.open_flags(FLAG_EVENTS)
        unwritten = _dict(get(checks.BLOCKER_PREFIX + "private-unwritten"))
        self.unwritten_error = _class_name(_dict(unwritten.get("detail")).get("error"))

    def gate_reason(self) -> str | None:
        return None if self.gate.open else self.gate.reason

    def when(self, t: datetime | None) -> str | None:
        return _when(t, self.now, self.tz)

    def next_sync(self) -> str | None:
        return _next_sync(self.settings, self.gate.open, self.last_turn, self.now)

    def flag_rows(self) -> list[dict]:
        return [_flag(self.db, ev) for ev in self.flags]

    def cause(self) -> str | None:
        """What stops the sync (sync_health, §16), else the gate's reason. A late consent pass
        that failed as a whole names its class and the remedy that can help."""
        from recordings.plaud.health import BLOCKER_PHRASES

        found = self.health.cause(tz=ZoneInfo(self.tz))
        if found == BLOCKER_PHRASES["private-unwritten"] and self.unwritten_error:
            return UNWRITTEN_STOPPED.format(self.unwritten_error)
        return found or self.gate_reason()

    def summary_view(self) -> dict:
        """The one summary line the Sync screen and Status share (§15.1, §15.2): what stops the
        sync, or the gate's reason. "All here" needs the last good listing, which Phase 2 writes
        and reads; until then a sync nothing stops has no good listing yet."""
        problem = self.cause()
        sentence = _cap(problem) if problem else NO_GOOD_LISTING
        return {"kind": "problem", "sentence": sentence, "explain": None, "see_status": True}

    def consent_view(self) -> dict | None:
        """What the worker read from the consent list (§12.1): its count, never its IDs (Task 13
        writes `count`). How many are on Plaud now needs the listing (Phase 2)."""
        if not self.consent:
            return None
        stop = self.consent.get("stop")
        return {
            "ids": _int(self.consent.get("count")),
            "on_plaud": None,
            "file_changed": _stamp(parse_stamp(self.consent.get("file_changed")), self.tz),
            "read_at": self.when(parse_stamp(self.consent.get("read_at"))),
            "stop": stop if isinstance(stop, str) and stop else None,
        }

    def schedule_off_since(self) -> datetime | None:
        """The schedule can't have been off before the last turn that ran ended, nor before the
        catch-up, while the gate kept every turn from running (§11.6). None: never ran."""
        stamps = (self.last_turn, self.health.catch_up_done)
        return max((t for t in stamps if t is not None), default=None)


# ---- The Sync screen ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _summary(kind: str, sentence: str) -> dict:
    return {"kind": kind, "sentence": sentence, "explain": None, "see_status": False}


def _empty_sync(reason: str | None) -> dict:
    """The Sync screen before any sync, or where there is nothing to read: every button off. The
    sections a later phase fills (the equations, Not here yet, Kept out, Gone, Parked, a hold, a
    breaker) are empty here until their readers come."""
    why = reason or NO_SYNC
    return {
        "demo": False,
        "available": False,
        "reason": why,
        "summary": _summary("no-sync", NO_SYNC),
        "flags": [],
        "hold": None,
        "breaker": None,
        "buttons": {"sync": why, "compare": why, "full": why, "import": why},
        **_handled(),
        "gate": None,
        "listed": False,  # until Phase 2 writes a listing: the screens then show no counts
        "full_estimate": FULL_UNKNOWN,
        "equation": None,
        "archive": None,
        "consent": None,
        "titles_hidden": None,
        "not_here": [],
        "import_all": {"count": 0, "review_more": 0},
        "kept_out": [],
        "updated": [],
        "gone": {"rows": [], "last_7_days": 0},
        "parked": [],
        "last_result": None,
        "next_sync": None,
    }


def _guarded(build, empty, unreadable):
    """A view from state.db: NoSyncYet without the 2b tables, and a state.db that can't be read
    gives its own line, never a traceback (Status has the restore advice, §9.5)."""
    import sqlite3

    from recordings.plaud.checks import NoSyncYet

    try:
        return build()
    except NoSyncYet:
        return empty()
    except sqlite3.DatabaseError:
        return unreadable()


def sync_view(
    settings: PlaudViewSettings | None, *, now: datetime, can_request: str | None
) -> dict:
    """The Sync screen (§15.1), as SyncView. `can_request` is why this app can't make requests
    (cannot_request_reason: the demo, no config.toml, the mirror's copy), or None."""
    if settings is not None and settings.demo_view is not None:
        return demo_view(settings.demo_view)["sync"]
    state = _open(settings)
    if settings is None or state is None:
        return _empty_sync(can_request)

    def unreadable() -> dict:
        return {**_empty_sync(UNREADABLE_SYNC), "summary": _summary("problem", UNREADABLE_SYNC)}

    return _guarded(
        lambda: _sync_from(_Read(settings, state, now), can_request),
        lambda: _empty_sync(can_request),
        unreadable,
    )


def _sync_from(r: _Read, can_request: str | None) -> dict:
    from recordings.plaud.settings import BAD_WORD

    gate = r.gate_reason()
    word = None if r.settings.keep_out_word_ok else BAD_WORD
    held_back = can_request or word or gate  # Compare runs whatever the gate says (§11.6)
    return {
        **_empty_sync(can_request),
        "available": can_request is None,
        "reason": can_request,
        "summary": r.summary_view(),
        "flags": r.flag_rows(),
        # Each button's own reason; the UI puts not_yet first for a kind not handled yet (G7).
        "buttons": {
            "sync": held_back,
            "compare": can_request,
            "full": held_back,
            "import": held_back,
        },
        "gate": gate,
        "consent": r.consent_view(),
        "updated": _updated(r),
        "last_result": _last_result(r),
        "next_sync": r.next_sync(),
    }


def _updated(r: _Read) -> list[dict]:
    """Updated on Plaud, the last 7 days (§15.1): the marker's `retagged-private` (Phase 1), and
    edit-sync's `updated` (Phase 3). The title is the recording's own, from the file the app last
    committed, but never for a recording with an open privacy flag: one kept out by title or
    consent-listed after it came in shows by ID alone, as everywhere else (P13)."""
    flagged = {ev.recording_id for ev in r.flags}
    rows, titles = [], {}
    events = r.db.events_since(r.now - RECENT, ("updated", "retagged-private"))
    for ev in sorted(events, key=lambda e: e.at, reverse=True):
        if ev.recording_id is None:
            continue
        if ev.recording_id not in titles:
            titles[ev.recording_id] = (
                None if ev.recording_id in flagged else _title_here(r.state, ev.recording_id)
            )
        parts = ["re-tagged private"]
        if ev.kind == "updated":
            parts = [p for p in ev.detail.get("parts") or [] if isinstance(p, str)] or ["updated"]
        rows.append(
            {
                "recording_id": ev.recording_id,
                "title": titles[ev.recording_id],
                "parts": parts,
                "at": r.when(ev.at),
            }
        )
    return rows


def _last_result(r: _Read) -> str | None:
    """The newest finished request's line, "Keep it here, 14:20: Kept here: …", so a phone that
    slept through the toast still sees it (§15.1). The UI shows this line, never one of its own.
    A preview's answer is its dialog, never a line."""
    rows = _q(
        r.state,
        "SELECT kind, select_all, finished_at, message FROM plaud_requests "
        "WHERE state IN ('done', 'failed') AND kind != 'release-preview' "
        "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",
    )
    if not rows:
        return None
    kind, select_all, finished, message = rows[0]
    label = "Import all" if kind == "import" and select_all else KIND_LABELS.get(kind, kind)
    return f"{label}, {r.when(parse_stamp(finished))}: {message}"


# ---- Status's sync panel ------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _empty_panel() -> dict:
    """Status's panel before any sync. The numbers and details a later phase fills (the listing,
    the sweep, the sign-in, Sync everything, held, gone, failing, parked, the runs) keep these
    empty values until their readers come."""
    return {
        "demo": False,
        "no_sync_yet": True,
        "summary": _summary("no-sync", NO_SYNC),
        "failing": None,
        "not_pinged": None,
        "conditions": [],
        "hold": None,
        "breaker": None,
        **_handled(),
        "listed": False,  # until Phase 2 writes a listing: Status then shows no zero counts
        "numbers": {
            "equation": None,
            "archive": None,
            "consent": None,
            "last_good_listing": None,
            "next_sync": None,
            "sweep": None,
            "sign_in": None,
            "full": None,
            "held": 0,
            "gone": 0,
            "failing": 0,
            "parked": 0,
            "worker": None,
            "healthchecks": None,
        },
        "details": {
            "normaliser": "",
            "fields": [],
            "census": {},
            "form_change": None,
            "changes_24h": {},
            "named_share": None,
            "runs": [],
            "keep_out_words": [],
            "malformed": 0,
        },
        "attention": [],
    }


def sync_panel(settings: PlaudViewSettings | None, *, now: datetime) -> dict:
    """Status's sync panel (§15.2), as SyncPanel: true sentences first, then the numbers, then
    the details. No title anywhere: recordings are named by ID (P13)."""
    if settings is not None and settings.demo_view is not None:
        return demo_view(settings.demo_view)["panel"]
    state = _open(settings)
    if settings is None or state is None:
        return _empty_panel()

    def unreadable() -> dict:
        return {
            **_empty_panel(),
            "no_sync_yet": False,
            "summary": _summary("problem", UNREADABLE_SYNC),
        }

    return _guarded(lambda: _panel_from(_Read(settings, state, now)), _empty_panel, unreadable)


def _worker(r: _Read) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, str | None]:
    """The worker's last report for the numbers, in plain words; its "silent", "stuck" or
    "couldn't start" reason; and its Needs attention line (§9.2). A start that failed writes the
    phase `failed` and its error's class (Task 13), shown as a class, never as text. The patterns
    pass at start runs as `checking`, its heartbeat carrying `done` and `total` (Task 13)."""
    from recordings.worker import HEARTBEAT_KEY, alive

    beat = r.state.meta(HEARTBEAT_KEY)
    if beat is None:
        return None, "the Plaud worker hasn't reported yet", NO_WORKER_YET
    try:
        data = _dict(json.loads(beat))
    except ValueError:
        data = {}
    at = parse_stamp(data.get("at"))
    phase = data.get("phase")
    if phase == "failed":
        error = _class_name(data.get("error")) or "Exception"
        report = f"last reported {r.when(at)} (couldn't start: `{error}`)" if at else None
        return report, "the Plaud worker couldn't start", WORKER_FAILED.format(error)
    words = PHASES.get(phase, "working") if isinstance(phase, str) else "working"
    done, total = _int(data.get("done")), _int(data.get("total"))
    if phase == "checking" and total > 0:
        words = f"checking, {done:,} of {total:,}"  # §15.2's "(checking, 412 of 1,234)"
    report = f"last reported {r.when(at)} ({words})" if at else None
    ok, why = alive(r.state, now=r.now)
    if ok or why is None:
        return report, None, None
    since = f" (last reported {r.when(at)})" if at else ""
    return report, why, f"{_cap(why)}{since}: check that the worker container is running."


def _not_pinged(r: _Read, cause: str | None) -> str | None:
    """§15.2: whenever the last ping is older than one schedule interval plus 10 minutes."""
    stale_after = timedelta(minutes=max(r.settings.schedule_minutes, 0)) + PING_GRACE
    last = r.health.last_ping
    if last is None:
        done = r.health.catch_up_done
        if done is None or r.now - done <= stale_after:
            return None  # a check never pinged stays silent before the catch-up (§11.6)
        return (
            "The sync's Healthchecks check hasn't been pinged since the catch-up: "
            f"{cause or 'no good sync since then'}."
        )
    if r.now - last[0] <= stale_after:
        return None
    return (
        f"The sync's Healthchecks check isn't being pinged since {r.when(last[0])}: "
        f"{cause or 'no good sync since then'}. It emails you about 2 hours after that."
    )


def _panel_from(r: _Read) -> dict:
    from recordings.plaud.flags import CONSENT_LATE, KEPT_OUT_LATE, PRIVATE_UNWRITTEN, SENTENCES
    from recordings.plaud.normalise import NORMALISER_VERSION
    from recordings.plaud.runlock import plaud_holder
    from recordings.plaud.settings import BAD_WORD

    tz, now, health = r.tz, r.now, r.health
    report, silent, worker_line = _worker(r)
    summary = r.summary_view()
    gate = r.gate_reason()
    cause = r.cause() or silent
    failing = None
    if health.failing is not None:
        since, why = health.failing
        # A turn that ran records its run phrase as `result` (Task 13). Phase 2 adds "Last good
        # listing 11:40." with its reader of the listing (§15.2).
        detail = health.last_turn[2].get("result") if health.last_turn else None
        detail = detail if isinstance(detail, str) and detail else CAUSES.get(why, why)
        failing = f"Plaud sync failing since {r.when(since)} ({detail})."
    disk = health.failing is not None and health.failing[1] == "disk"
    stop = r.consent.get("stop")
    consent_stop = (
        f"Plaud imports stopped: {stop if isinstance(stop, str) and stop else CONSENT_UNREADABLE}."
    )
    late = {
        CONSENT_LATE: "Recording {} is on the consent list, but in the archive. "
        "Take it out by hand (runbook).",
        KEPT_OUT_LATE: "Recording {} was kept out by title after it came in. "
        "Take it out by hand (runbook), or Keep it here.",
        PRIVATE_UNWRITTEN: "Recording {} should be private, but its file was edited outside "
        "the app: run `recordings reindex`.",
    }

    def flag_line(ev: Event) -> str:
        said = _sentence(ev)  # names the recording itself when its cause needs its own remedy
        return said if said != SENTENCES[ev.kind] else late[ev.kind].format(ev.recording_id)

    flag_lines = [flag_line(ev) for ev in r.flags if ev.kind in late]
    off_since = r.schedule_off_since() if r.settings.schedule_minutes <= 0 else None

    conditions: list[str] = []
    if "consent" in health.blockers:
        conditions.append(consent_stop)
    conditions += flag_lines
    if disk:
        conditions.append("Plaud imports stopped: the disk is too full to import.")
    if gate:
        conditions.append(f"{gate}.")
    if r.settings.schedule_minutes <= 0:
        conditions.append(
            f"Scheduled sync is off since {_stamp(off_since, tz)}."
            if off_since
            else "Scheduled sync is off."
        )
    if not r.settings.auto_import:
        conditions.append("Auto-import is off: new recordings wait for you on the Sync screen.")
    if not r.settings.keep_out_word_ok:
        conditions.append(f"Plaud sync is idle: {BAD_WORD}.")
    # P12: a condition the summary line already says isn't said again under it.
    conditions = [c for c in conditions if c.removesuffix(".") != summary["sentence"]]

    attention: list[str] = []
    if health.failing is not None and now - health.failing[0] > FAILING_FOR:
        attention.append(f"Plaud sync has been failing since {r.when(health.failing[0])}.")
    if disk:
        attention.append("Plaud imports stopped: the disk is too full to import.")
    if "consent" in health.blockers:
        attention.append(consent_stop)
    if r.unwritten_error:
        attention.append(_cap(UNWRITTEN_STOPPED.format(r.unwritten_error)) + ".")
    attention += flag_lines
    if worker_line:
        attention.append(worker_line)
    holder = plaud_holder(r.state)
    if holder is not None:
        job, since = holder
        limit = STUCK_AFTER_LONG if job in LONG_JOBS else STUCK_AFTER
        if now - since > limit:  # a start in the future (a clock put right) is never stuck
            label = JOB_LABELS.get(job, job)
            attention.append(f"{label} has run since {r.when(since)}: it may be stuck.")
    if (
        off_since is not None
        and health.catch_up_done is not None
        and now - off_since >= SCHEDULE_OFF_FOR
    ):
        attention.append(
            f"Scheduled sync has been off since {_stamp(off_since, tz)}: set [plaud] "
            "schedule_minutes to turn it back on, or pause the sync's Healthchecks check (runbook)."
        )
    failed_since = parse_stamp(r.ping.get("failed_since"))
    if (
        r.ping.get("ok") is False
        and failed_since is not None
        and now - failed_since >= PING_FAILING_FOR
    ):
        attention.append(PING_FAILING)

    healthchecks = None
    if health.last_ping is not None:
        at, ok, status = health.last_ping
        healthchecks = (
            f"last pinged {r.when(at)}"
            if ok
            else f"last ping failed {r.when(at)} "
            f"({f'HTTP {status}' if status is not None else 'unreachable'})"
        )
    panel = _empty_panel()
    panel["numbers"].update(
        {
            "consent": r.consent_view(),
            "next_sync": r.next_sync(),
            "worker": report,
            "healthchecks": healthchecks,
        }
    )
    panel["details"].update({"normaliser": str(NORMALISER_VERSION), "keep_out_words": r.words})
    panel.update(
        {
            "no_sync_yet": False,
            "summary": summary,
            "failing": failing,
            "not_pinged": _not_pinged(r, cause),
            "conditions": conditions,
            "attention": attention,
        }
    )
    return panel


# ---- The Library's arrivals cue ---------------------------------------------------------------


def arrivals(settings: PlaudViewSettings | None, *, since: datetime, now: datetime) -> dict:
    """The Library's cue (§15.3, P10): what came in since `since` (the page's load or its last
    Refresh, decision 22), and the open privacy flags, by count only."""
    zero = {"new": 0, "private": 0, "updated": 0, "kept_out_late": 0, "consent_late": 0}
    if settings is not None and settings.demo_view is not None:
        return demo_view(settings.demo_view)["arrivals"]
    state = _open(settings)
    if state is None:
        return zero

    def build() -> dict:
        from recordings.plaud.checks import FLAG_KINDS, PlaudDB

        db = PlaudDB(state)
        seen = Counter(e.kind for e in db.events_since(since, ARRIVAL_EVENTS) if e.at <= now)
        flags = Counter(e.kind for e in db.open_flags(FLAG_KINDS))
        return {
            "new": seen["imported"],
            "private": seen["arrived-private"],
            "updated": seen["updated"] + seen["retagged-private"],
            "kept_out_late": flags["kept-out-late"],
            "consent_late": flags["consent-late"],
        }

    return _guarded(build, lambda: zero, lambda: zero)


# ---- Details' Plaud lines ---------------------------------------------------------------------


def recording_plaud(
    settings: PlaudViewSettings | None, recording_id: str, *, now: datetime
) -> dict | None:
    """Details' Plaud lines (§15.3), as RecordingPlaud; None for a recording with no Plaud
    source, and in the demos, whose canned view has no recordings of its own. When it was checked
    and when next, and gone from Plaud, come with the checks (Phase 3): None until then."""
    if settings is None or settings.demo_view is not None:
        return None
    state = _open(settings)
    if state is None:
        return None
    import sqlite3

    from recordings.plaud.checks import NoSyncYet

    try:
        body = _body(state, recording_id)
    except sqlite3.DatabaseError:
        return None
    refs = [
        s["ref"]
        for s in (body or {}).get("sources") or []
        if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("kind") == "plaud" and isinstance(s.get("ref"), str)
    ]
    if not refs:
        return None
    from recordings.refs import canonical_plaud_id

    seen: set[str] = set()
    unique = []
    for ref in refs:  # one line per recording on Plaud, whichever form its sources use
        if canonical_plaud_id(ref) not in seen:
            seen.add(canonical_plaud_id(ref))
            unique.append(ref)
    bare = {
        "plaud_ids": [{"id": ref, "copy_id": _copy_form(ref)} for ref in unique],
        "checked": None,
        "next_by": None,
        "gone_since": None,
        "tagged_private": None,
        "removed_private": None,
        "flags": [],
        "resync": None,
        **_handled(),
    }
    try:
        return {**bare, **_recording_lines(settings, state, recording_id, body or {}, unique)}
    except NoSyncYet:
        return bare  # before any sync: the IDs, for `make consent-add`
    except sqlite3.DatabaseError:
        return bare


def _recording_lines(
    settings: PlaudViewSettings,
    state: State,
    recording_id: str,
    body: dict,
    refs: list[str],
) -> dict:
    from recordings.models import is_private_tag
    from recordings.plaud.checks import PlaudDB
    from recordings.plaud.flags import CONSENT_LATE
    from recordings.plaud.gate import gate_now

    tz = settings.timezone_name
    db = PlaudDB(state)
    plaud_ids, kept_out = [], False
    for ref in refs:
        row = db.listing(ref)
        listed = row.listed_id if row is not None else ref
        kept_out = kept_out or (row is not None and row.kept_out_at is not None)
        plaud_ids.append({"id": listed, "copy_id": _copy_form(listed)})
    tags = [
        t for t in body.get("tags") or [] if isinstance(t, dict) and isinstance(t.get("tag"), str)
    ]
    private_now = any(is_private_tag(t["tag"]) for t in tags)
    auto_private = any(is_private_tag(t["tag"]) and t.get("by") == "auto" for t in tags)
    events = _q(
        state,
        "SELECT at, kind, detail FROM plaud_events WHERE recording_id = ? AND kind IN (?, ?) "
        "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",
        (recording_id, *PRIVATE_EVENTS),
    )
    tagged = removed = None
    if events:
        raw_at, kind, raw_detail = events[0]
        try:
            detail = _dict(json.loads(raw_detail))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            detail = {}
        on = _date(parse_stamp(raw_at), tz)
        reason = (
            ARRIVED_PRIVATE if kind == "arrived-private" else WHY_DETAILS.get(detail.get("why"))
        )
        if private_now:
            tagged = f"Tagged private by the sync on {on}" + (f": {reason}" if reason else "")
        else:  # decision 3, made visible
            when = _removed_on(state, recording_id, tz)
            removed = (
                f"Tagged private by the sync on {on}. You removed it"
                f"{f' on {when}' if when else ''}. It comes back only if its Plaud title "
                "changes to a private one."
            )
    elif auto_private:
        tagged = "Tagged private by the sync"  # decision 15: its event aged out after 90 days
    flags = [_flag(db, ev) for ev in db.open_flags(FLAG_EVENTS) if ev.recording_id == recording_id]
    gate = gate_now(db)
    if not gate.open:
        resync = gate.reason
    elif any(f["kind"] == CONSENT_LATE for f in flags):
        resync = "Not checked: on the consent list"
    elif kept_out:
        resync = "Not checked: kept out"
    else:
        resync = None
    return {
        "plaud_ids": plaud_ids,
        "tagged_private": tagged,
        "removed_private": removed,
        "flags": flags,
        "resync": resync,
    }


def _removed_on(state: State, recording_id: str, tz: str) -> str | None:
    """The date of the revision that took the recording's `private` away (§15.3), from the merge
    bases state.db keeps (KEEP_REVISIONS); None once it has aged out of them."""
    from recordings.ids import relative_dir
    from recordings.models import is_private_tag

    rel = (relative_dir(recording_id) / "recording.json").as_posix()
    rows = _q(
        state,
        "SELECT body, written_at FROM revisions WHERE file = ? AND committed = 1 ORDER BY id",
        (rel,),
    )
    found, before = None, False
    for raw, written in rows:
        try:
            tags = _dict(json.loads(raw)).get("tags") or []
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        private = any(isinstance(t, dict) and is_private_tag(str(t.get("tag", ""))) for t in tags)
        if before and not private:
            found = parse_stamp(written)
        before = private
    return _date(found, tz)


# ---- The canned view (decision 23) --------------------------------------------------------------


def demo_view(path: Path) -> dict:
    """The canned view, hand-written in demo/plaud-sync.json, as {"sync", "panel", "arrivals"}:
    the UI's contract for every section, Phase 2's and 3's included. Whatever it says, every
    action is off and the demo's notes show (§15.5). It never raises: a missing or broken file
    gives an empty canned view, so the demo still starts."""
    try:
        raw = _dict(json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        raw = {}
    sync = _empty_sync(DEMO_NOTE)
    sync.update({k: v for k, v in _dict(raw.get("sync")).items() if k in sync})
    sync.update(
        {
            "demo": True,
            "available": False,
            "reason": DEMO_NOTE,
            "summary": _summary("demo", DEMO_NOTE),
            "buttons": dict.fromkeys(("sync", "compare", "full", "import"), DEMO_NOTE),
            **_handled(),
            "gate": None,
            "flags": [{**_dict(f), "keep_here": False} for f in sync["flags"] or []],
            "not_here": [{**_dict(row), "park": False} for row in sync["not_here"] or []],
            "kept_out": [{**_dict(row), "release": False} for row in sync["kept_out"] or []],
            "hold": {**sync["hold"], "accept": False, "refused": DEMO_NOTE}
            if isinstance(sync["hold"], dict)
            else None,
            "breaker": {**sync["breaker"], "accept": False}
            if isinstance(sync["breaker"], dict)
            else None,
        }
    )
    panel = _empty_panel()
    panel.update({k: v for k, v in _dict(raw.get("panel")).items() if k in panel})
    panel.update(
        {
            "demo": True,
            "no_sync_yet": False,
            "summary": _summary("demo", DEMO_STATUS),
            **_handled(),
            "hold": {**panel["hold"], "accept": False, "refused": DEMO_NOTE}
            if isinstance(panel["hold"], dict)
            else None,
            "breaker": {**panel["breaker"], "accept": False}
            if isinstance(panel["breaker"], dict)
            else None,
            "attention": [],  # the demo needs nothing of anyone
        }
    )
    counts = _dict(raw.get("arrivals"))
    keys = ("new", "private", "updated", "kept_out_late", "consent_late")
    return {"sync": sync, "panel": panel, "arrivals": {k: _int(counts.get(k)) for k in keys}}
```

and append:

```ts
// ---- Plaud (2b spec §9.3, §15; phase 1 plan, Task 19) ----------------------------------------
// The server formats every date and time, in the default zone. Every `string | null` button field
// is null when the button is enabled, else the reason it isn't. No title reaches the browser
// except in the Sync screen's own rows (Not here yet, Updated) and Release's question. Phase 1's
// views fill Phase 1's data and leave the rest empty; the canned view (demo/plaud-sync.json) fills
// every field, and is the contract Phase 2's and 3's readers write to.

export type PlaudKind = "compare" | "sync" | "import" | "resync" | "full" | "accept" | "accept-changes"
  | "release-preview" | "release" | "unrelease" | "park" | "unpark" | "keep-here";
/** The `plaud_request` input (spec §9.3). Never sent on load, from a URL, its hash or storage. */
export interface PlaudRequest { request_id: string; kind: PlaudKind; plaud_ids: string[]; recording_ids: string[]; all: boolean }
export interface ReleasePreview { plaud_id: string; title: string; date: string; time: string; duration: string | null; next_sync: string | null }
/** The `plaud_result` message. `result` holds counts and IDs, never a title. */
export interface PlaudResult {
  request_id: string; kind: PlaudKind | null;
  state: "queued" | "running" | "done" | "failed" | "expired" | "refused";
  message: string; progress: { done: number; total: number } | null;
  result: Record<string, number | string | string[]> | null;
  preview: ReleasePreview | null; // release-preview only, for the asking session: null until Phase 2 builds it
}
/** What the worker can do yet, on every view: a request button of any other kind is disabled with
 * `not_yet` as its reason (Phase 1 handles "keep-here" alone; each phase widens it). */
export interface Handled { handled: PlaudKind[]; not_yet: string }
export interface SyncSummaryView { kind: "all-here" | "problem" | "no-sync" | "demo"; sentence: string; explain: string | null; see_status: boolean }
export interface SyncFlag {
  kind: "kept-out-late" | "consent-late" | "private-unwritten" | "rekeyed";
  recording_id: string | null; plaud_id: string | null; copy_id: string | null;
  sentence: string; keep_here: boolean; date: string | null; duration: string | null;
}
export interface SyncHold { sentence: string; accept: boolean; refused: string | null }
export interface SyncBreaker { sentence: string; accept: boolean; code_fix: string | null; fields: string[] }
export interface SyncEquation { listed: number; here: number; waiting: number; excluded: number; missing: number; arrive_private: number; listing_at: string | null }
export interface ArchiveEquation { from_plaud: number; here: number; gone: number; absent: number }
export interface ConsentSummary { ids: number; on_plaud: number | null; file_changed: string | null; read_at: string | null; stop: string | null }
export interface NotHereRow { plaud_id: string; copy_id: string; date: string; time: string; duration: string | null; title: string | null; arrives_private: boolean; state: string; review: boolean; park: boolean }
export interface KeptOutRow { plaud_id: string; copy_id: string; date: string | null; time: string | null; duration: string | null; by: "consent" | "title" | "rekeyed" | "was-title"; release: boolean; released: string | null }
export interface UpdatedRow { recording_id: string; title: string | null; parts: string[]; at: string }
export interface GoneRow { recording_id: string; since: string }
export interface ParkedRow { id: string; kind: "recording" | "plaud" }
export interface SyncView extends Handled {
  demo: boolean; available: boolean; reason: string | null;
  gate: string | null; // the gate's reason while it is closed: every kind but Compare and Keep it here waits (§11.6)
  listed: boolean; // false until Phase 2 writes a listing: the screen then shows no counts from one
  summary: SyncSummaryView; flags: SyncFlag[]; hold: SyncHold | null; breaker: SyncBreaker | null;
  buttons: { sync: string | null; compare: string | null; full: string | null; import: string | null };
  full_estimate: string; // "about 40 minutes" | "unknown until the first run"
  equation: SyncEquation | null; archive: ArchiveEquation | null; consent: ConsentSummary | null;
  titles_hidden: string | null; // "titles hidden until the consent list reads" | "titles hidden while Plaud's IDs look changed"
  not_here: NotHereRow[]; import_all: { count: number; review_more: number };
  kept_out: KeptOutRow[]; updated: UpdatedRow[]; gone: { rows: GoneRow[]; last_7_days: number }; parked: ParkedRow[];
  last_result: string | null; next_sync: string | null;
}
export interface SyncPanel extends Handled {
  demo: boolean; no_sync_yet: boolean;
  listed: boolean; // false until Phase 2 writes a listing: Status then shows no zero counts
  summary: SyncSummaryView; failing: string | null; not_pinged: string | null; conditions: string[];
  hold: SyncHold | null; breaker: SyncBreaker | null;
  numbers: {
    equation: SyncEquation | null; archive: ArchiveEquation | null; consent: ConsentSummary | null;
    last_good_listing: string | null; next_sync: string | null; sweep: string | null; sign_in: string | null;
    full: string | null; held: number; gone: number; failing: number; parked: number;
    worker: string | null; healthchecks: string | null;
  };
  details: {
    normaliser: string; fields: string[]; census: Record<string, number>; form_change: string | null;
    changes_24h: Record<string, number>; named_share: string | null; runs: { at: string; result: string }[];
    keep_out_words: string[]; malformed: number;
  };
  attention: string[];
}
export interface Arrivals { new: number; private: number; updated: number; kept_out_late: number; consent_late: number }
export interface RecordingPlaud extends Handled {
  plaud_ids: { id: string; copy_id: string }[]; checked: string | null; next_by: string | null;
  gone_since: string | null; tagged_private: string | null; removed_private: string | null;
  flags: SyncFlag[]; resync: string | null;
}
```

- Produces (`shiny_app.py`):
  - input `plaud_request`: an event input, mounted once with `null`, read with `@reactive.event` (its default `ignore_none`); `submit` runs on `asyncio.to_thread`, never on the tag service's threads.
  - output `plaud_sync`: `sync_view(...)`, with `reactive.invalidate_later(60)` and again when one of the session's requests finishes (so its `last_result` follows them).
  - output `plaud_arrivals`: `arrivals(since=<the later of the session's start and its last Refresh>)` (decision 22), every 60 seconds.
  - message `plaud_result`: `Reply.to_dict()` plus `preview: None` (Phase 2's release-preview handler fills it). While the session has a pending request, its row is read every 2 seconds and progress and the final reply are sent.

  ```ts
  export interface Plaud {
    send(kind: PlaudKind, opts?: { plaud_ids?: string[]; recording_ids?: string[]; all?: boolean }): string;   // the new request_id
    results: Record<string, PlaudResult>;   // by request_id, the newest reply each
    last: PlaudResult | null;
    lastLine: string | null;                // the server's newest result line (SyncView.last_result)
    available: boolean; reason: string | null;
    why(kind: PlaudKind): string | null;    // kindReason against the Sync view; NO_PLAUD before it comes
    handles(kind: PlaudKind): boolean;      // the kind is in SyncView.handled (false before the view): the Library draws no button for one it isn't
    gate: string | null;                    // the gate's reason while it is closed (SyncView.gate)
  }
  export const NO_PLAUD = "Plaud sync isn't available here";
  export function kindReason(kind: PlaudKind, why: string | null, view: Handled): string | null;   // why, else not_yet for a kind not handled, else null
  export const PlaudContext: React.Context<Plaud | null>;
  export function usePlaudContext(): Plaud;
  export function usePlaud(view: SyncView | undefined, onView?: () => void): Plaud;   // mounted once in App; the plaud_result handler lives here; onView: an import's toast's View
  ```

```ts
  sent: {} as Record<string, unknown[]>,
  setters: {} as Record<string, (value: unknown) => void>,
  handlers: {} as Record<string, (data: unknown) => void>,
}));
vi.mock("../sr", () => ({
  useSetShinyInput: (id: string) => {
    shiny.setters[id] ??= (value: unknown) => {
      (shiny.sent[id] ??= []).push(value);
    };
    return shiny.setters[id];
  },
  useShinyMessageHandler: (id: string, handler: (data: unknown) => void) => {
    shiny.handlers[id] = handler;
  },
}));

vi.mock("sonner", () => {
  sonner.toast = vi.fn();

  });
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from recordings.archive import Archive

from recordings_ui.status import StatusSettings

if TYPE_CHECKING:

_status: StatusSettings | None = None
_tagging: TagService | None = None
_plaud: PlaudViewSettings | None = None
_plaud_state: State | None = None
_plaud_reason: str | None = None


def configure(
    archive: Archive | None,
    *,
    media_base: str | None = None,
    status: StatusSettings | None = None,
    tagging: TagService | None = None,
    plaud: PlaudViewSettings | None = None,
    plaud_state: State | None = None,
    plaud_reason: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """media_base: where the browser finds media files, as `<media_base><media.file>`.

    None (the server) links the FastAPI route /media/{id}. The static Pages demo, which has no
    FastAPI, sets "../media/" (spec §17.1). status: where Status reads its records; None in demo
    mode, which has no state folder. tagging: the process's tag service (tagging spec §5): the
    archive store from create_app, or the memory store from the Pages entry. plaud: what the
    Plaud views read (2b spec §15): the server's state folder and [plaud] keys, or the demos'
    canned view (2b phase 1 plan, decision 23); None with no config.toml. plaud_state: the
    state.db Plaud requests are inserted into (§9.3); plaud_reason: why this app can't make
    requests (cannot_request_reason), or None. With a reason, no request is ever inserted.
    """
    global _archive, _media_base, _status, _tagging, _plaud, _plaud_state, _plaud_reason
    _archive = archive
    _media_base = media_base
    _status = status
    _tagging = tagging
    _plaud = plaud
    _plaud_state = plaud_state
    _plaud_reason = plaud_reason


def archive() -> Archive:
    if _archive is None:
        raise RuntimeError("recordings_ui.runtime.configure() was not called")
    return _archive


def media_base() -> str | None:
    return _media_base


def status_settings() -> StatusSettings | None:
    return _status


def tagging() -> TagService:
    if _tagging is None:
        raise RuntimeError("recordings_ui.runtime.configure() was not given a tag service")
    return _tagging


def plaud_settings() -> PlaudViewSettings | None:
    return _plaud


def plaud_state() -> State | None:
    return _plaud_state


def plaud_reason() -> str | None:
    return _plaud_reason
```
