- [ ] **Step 6: Details' Plaud lines.** Create `packages/ui/frontend/src/components/PlaudDetails.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useContext, useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import { FINAL, NO_PLAUD, PlaudContext, kindReason } from "../plaud/usePlaud";
import { useShinyOutputValue } from "../sr";
import type { PlaudResult, RecordingPlaud, RecordingView } from "../types";
import { CopyId, FlagRow } from "./SyncSummary";

/** A Re-sync's reply in place (§14.6): its progress while it runs, then its fixed phrase. */
function replyText(r: PlaudResult): string {
  if (FINAL.has(r.state) || !r.progress) return r.message;
  return `${r.message} (${r.progress.done} of ${r.progress.total})`;
}

/** Details' Plaud lines (2b spec §15.3): when it was checked and when next, Re-sync from Plaud
 * with its result inline, each Plaud ID with Copy ID, gone from Plaud, why the sync tagged it
 * private (or decision 3, once Dan removed that), and its flags, each with its next step. The
 * recording is the one Details shows: the `recording` output's, which App holds. Re-sync is
 * drawn only once the worker handles it, and the checked line only once checks can run (both
 * Phase 3's; a checked time already recorded still shows): Phase 1's Details has no dead button.
 * When drawn, Re-sync says why it is off: this app can't ask, or the server's reason (the gate, a
 * consent listing, a keep-out). */
export function PlaudDetails({ plaud }: { plaud: RecordingPlaud }) {
  const ctx = useContext(PlaudContext);
  const recordingId = useShinyOutputValue<RecordingView | null>("recording")?.id ?? null;
  const [resyncId, setResyncId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const why = !ctx ? NO_PLAUD : ctx.available ? null : (ctx.reason ?? NO_PLAUD);
  const offered = plaud.handled.includes("resync");
  const resyncWhy = kindReason("resync", why, plaud) ?? plaud.resync;
  const reply = resyncId && ctx ? ctx.results[resyncId] : undefined;
  return (
    <section className="plaud-details" data-testid="plaud-details" aria-labelledby="plaud-details-h">
      <h3 id="plaud-details-h">Plaud</h3>
      {(offered || plaud.checked) && (
        <p data-testid="plaud-checked">
          Plaud: {plaud.checked ? `checked ${plaud.checked}` : "not checked yet"}
          {plaud.next_by && ` · next by ${plaud.next_by}`}
        </p>
      )}
      {offered && (
        <p className="plaud-resync">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" data-request="resync" disabled={resyncWhy !== null || !recordingId}
            onClick={() => {
              if (ctx && recordingId) setResyncId(ctx.send("resync", { recording_ids: [recordingId] }));
            }}>
            Re-sync from Plaud
          </Button>
          {resyncWhy && <span className="muted"> {resyncWhy}</span>}
          {reply && <span role="status" data-testid="resync-reply"> {replyText(reply)}</span>}
        </p>
      )}
      <ul className="plaud-ids">
        {plaud.plaud_ids.map((p) => (
          <li key={p.id}><span className="mono">{p.id}</span> <CopyId text={p.copy_id} label={p.id} /></li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {plaud.gone_since && <p data-testid="plaud-gone">Gone from Plaud since {plaud.gone_since} (kept)</p>}
      {plaud.tagged_private && <p data-testid="plaud-private">{plaud.tagged_private}</p>}
      {plaud.removed_private && <p data-testid="plaud-private">{plaud.removed_private}</p>}
      {plaud.flags.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="sync-rows">
          {plaud.flags.map((f) => (
            <FlagRow key={f.kind} flag={f} why={kindReason("keep-here", why, plaud)}
              onKeepHere={() => {
                const id = f.recording_id ?? recordingId;
                if (ctx && id) ctx.send("keep-here", { recording_ids: [id] });
              }} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

"""The Sync screen and Status's sync panel in demo mode (2b spec §15.4, §15.5, §21; phase 1 plan,
Task 24): the canned view at 1,280 and 320 pixels, four tabs on one row, every request button
disabled with the demo's note, 44-pixel targets on a phone, axe in both themes, and a clean
console. Run with `make e2e`; each test gets its own demo server (conftest's `server`)."""

import re
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect
from recordings_ui.plaud import DEMO_NOTE, DEMO_STATUS

pytestmark = pytest.mark.e2e

AXE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "frontend" / "node_modules" / "axe-core" / "axe.min.js"
WCAG = ["wcag2a", "wcag2aa", "wcag21a", "wcag21aa"]
# Every button, disclosure and checkbox target in `scope` under 44 px tall, by its text. Inline
# links in a sentence are WCAG 2.5.8's inline exception, and aren't counted.
SMALL_TARGETS = """(scope) => [...document.querySelectorAll(
        `${scope} button, ${scope} summary, ${scope} .sync-check`)]
    .map((el) => [el, el.getBoundingClientRect()])
    .filter(([, r]) => r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && r.height < 43.5)
    .map(([el, r]) => `${(el.textContent || el.className).trim()}: ${Math.round(r.height)} px`)"""
SIDEWAYS = """(sel) => {
    const el = document.querySelector(sel);
    return [el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth,
            document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth];
}"""
# Outputs whose Shiny binding points at an element no longer in the page (test_library.py).
DETACHED = """() => Object.entries(window.Shiny.shinyapp.$bindings)
    .filter(([, binding]) => binding.el && !binding.el.isConnected).map(([id]) => id)"""
TWO_FRAMES = "() => new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)))"


def axe(page: Page, selector: str) -> list[str]:
    """axe-core's WCAG A and AA violations inside `selector`, as in test_tagging.py."""
    if not page.evaluate("() => typeof window.axe === 'object'"):
        page.add_script_tag(path=str(AXE))
    return page.evaluate(
        """async ([selector, tags]) => {
            const el = document.querySelector(selector);
            if (!el) throw new Error(`nothing matches ${selector}`);
            const result = await axe.run(el, { runOnly: { type: "tag", values: tags } });
            return result.violations.map((v) => `${v.id} (${v.nodes.length}): `
                + v.nodes.slice(0, 3).map((n) => n.target.join(" ")).join(" | "));
        }""",
        [selector, WCAG],
    )


def open_sync(page: Page, url: str) -> None:
    page.goto(f"{url}/#/add")
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("sync-page")).to_be_visible()


def open_more(page: Page) -> None:
    page.locator("details.sync-more > summary").click()
    expect(page.locator("[data-request=full]")).to_be_visible()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("width", [1280, 320])
def test_the_sync_screen_and_status_panel_draw_the_canned_view_at_1280_and_320(
    page: Page, server, console, width
):
    # C9.01.
    page.set_viewport_size({"width": width, "height": 800})
    open_sync(page, server.url)
    summary = page.get_by_test_id("sync-summary")
    expect(summary).to_contain_text(DEMO_NOTE)
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("not-here-row")).to_have_count(3)
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("kept-out-row")).to_have_count(2)
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("updated-row")).to_have_count(1)
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("sync-equations")).to_contain_text(
        "Listed 9 = 4 here + 2 waiting + 2 excluded + 1 missing"
    )
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("sync-not-here")).to_contain_text("Synthetic 042")
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("sync-kept-out")).not_to_contain_text("Synthetic")
    # The summary comes first (§15.4), and nothing scrolls sideways.
    top = summary.bounding_box()["y"]
    assert top < page.get_by_test_id("sync-actions").bounding_box()["y"]
    assert page.evaluate(SIDEWAYS, "[data-testid=sync-page]") == [0, 0]
    page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Pages").get_by_role("button", name="Status").click()
    panel = page.get_by_test_id("sync-panel")
    expect(panel).to_contain_text(DEMO_STATUS)
    expect(panel.get_by_test_id("sync-numbers")).to_contain_text("14:20 (9 listed)")
    expect(panel.get_by_test_id("sync-details")).not_to_have_attribute("open", "")
    assert page.evaluate(SIDEWAYS, "[data-testid=status-page]") == [0, 0]


def test_the_four_tabs_stay_on_one_row_at_320(page: Page, server, console):
    page.set_viewport_size({"width": 320, "height": 640})
    open_sync(page, server.url)
    tabs = page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Pages").get_by_role("button")
    expect(tabs).to_have_text(["Library", "Tags", "Add", "Status"])
    rows = {round(tabs.nth(i).bounding_box()["y"]) for i in range(4)}
    assert len(rows) == 1, rows
    # The logo's mark without its name, and the theme switch as one icon.
    expect(page.locator(".logo-name")).to_be_hidden()
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("theme-light")).to_be_hidden()
    cycle = page.get_by_test_id("theme-cycle")
    expect(cycle).to_be_visible()
    cycle.click()  # system → dark
    expect(page.locator("html")).to_have_class(re.compile(r"\bdark\b"))
    assert page.evaluate(SIDEWAYS, ".topbar") == [0, 0]


def test_every_sync_button_is_disabled_with_the_demo_note(page: Page, server, console):
    open_sync(page, server.url)
    open_more(page)
    asks = page.locator("[data-request]")
    assert asks.count() >= 5  # Sync now, Compare, Sync everything, Import selected, Import all
    for i in range(asks.count()):
        expect(asks.nth(i)).to_be_disabled()
    expect(page.locator(".sync-why", has_text=DEMO_NOTE).first).to_be_visible()
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("copy-id").first).to_be_enabled()  # copying sends nothing
    page.goto(f"{server.url}/#/status")
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("sync-panel")).to_be_visible()
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("sync-panel").locator("[data-request]:enabled")).to_have_count(0)


def test_targets_are_at_least_44_pixels_at_320(page: Page, server, console):
    page.set_viewport_size({"width": 320, "height": 800})
    open_sync(page, server.url)
    open_more(page)
    assert page.evaluate(SMALL_TARGETS, ".sync-page") == []
    full = page.locator("[data-request=compare]").bounding_box()
    card = page.get_by_test_id("sync-actions").bounding_box()

    page.goto(f"{server.url}/#/status")

    page.get_by_test_id("sync-details").locator("summary").click()
    assert page.evaluate(SMALL_TARGETS, ".sync-panel") == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("theme", ["light", "dark"])
def test_axe_finds_nothing_in_light_and_dark(page: Page, server, console, theme):

def test_the_console_stays_clean(page: Page, server, console):
    # The `console` fixture fails the test on any console error. Leaving the Sync screen leaves no
    # output bound to a removed element (CLAUDE.md: every output is subscribed in App).
    open_sync(page, server.url)
    open_more(page)
    nav = page.get_by_role("navigation", name="Pages")
    nav.get_by_role("button", name="Status").click()
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("sync-panel")).to_be_visible()
    page.get_by_test_id("sync-details").locator("summary").click()
    nav.get_by_role("button", name="Library").click()
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("recording-row")).to_have_count(4)
    nav.get_by_role("button", name="Add").click()
    expect(page.get_by_test_id("sync-page")).to_be_visible()
    page.evaluate(TWO_FRAMES)
    assert page.evaluate(DETACHED) == []

```python
def _plaud_request(client: TestClient, request: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """A plaud_request crafted on the demo's websocket, as a page's devtools could send it, and
    the plaud_result replies to it. It waits for the Library first, so the session is running."""
    replies: list[dict] = []
    with client.websocket_connect(
        "ws://localhost/websocket/", headers={"Origin": "http://localhost"}
    ) as ws:
        ws.send_text(
            json.dumps({"method": "init", "data": {".clientdata_output_library_hidden": False}})
        )

        def read() -> None:
            seen: set[str] = set()
            while "library" not in seen:
                seen.update(json.loads(ws.receive_text()).get("values", {}))
            update = {"plaud_request:shinyreact.default": request}
            ws.send_text(json.dumps({"method": "update", "data": update}))
            while not replies:
                custom = json.loads(ws.receive_text()).get("custom", {})
                message = custom.get("shinyReactMessage", {})
                if message.get("id") == "plaud_result":
                    replies.append(message["data"])

        reader = threading.Thread(target=read, daemon=True)
        reader.start()
        reader.join(20)  # receive_text has no timeout: a missing reply must not hang
    return replies


CRAFTED = {
    "request_id": "guard0002demo",
    "kind": "import",
    "plaud_ids": [],
    "recording_ids": [],
    "all": True,
}


def test_the_demo_refuses_a_crafted_plaud_request():
    # why: §15.5. The demo has no writable state.db for requests (§9.3): its buttons are off, and
    # a request crafted anyway is refused with the reason, never queued.
    from recordings_ui.plaud import cannot_request_reason

    settings = from_env({}, demo=True)
    try:
        with TestClient(create_app(settings), base_url="http://localhost") as client:
            replies = _plaud_request(client, CRAFTED)
    finally:
        runtime.configure(None)
    (reply,) = replies
    assert (reply["request_id"], reply["state"]) == ("guard0002demo", "refused")
    assert reply["message"] == cannot_request_reason(settings, None)


def test_the_demos_state_db_never_gets_a_request_row():
    settings = from_env({}, demo=True)
    try:
        with TestClient(create_app(settings), base_url="http://localhost") as client:
            assert _plaud_request(client, {**CRAFTED, "request_id": "guard0003demo"})
            # The demo's own Writer has opened by now, so its temporary state.db exists.
            assert runtime.tagging().store.wait_open(30) == (True, None)
    finally:
        runtime.configure(None)
    db = settings.archive.parent / "state" / "state.db"
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(f"file:{db}?mode=ro", uri=True)) as conn:
        assert conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plaud_requests").fetchone() == (0,)


def test_the_demo_starts_no_worker(tmp_path):
    # why: §15.5, "no worker, no Plaud code, no network". In a process of its own, so another
    # test's import can't hide one: the demo serves its Sync screen, Status and arrivals cue, and
    # never imports the worker, the client or the token store, nor reports a heartbeat.
    probe = tmp_path / "probe.py"
    probe.write_text(
        """
import json, sys, threading
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from recordings_ui import runtime
from recordings_ui.app import create_app
from recordings_ui.settings import from_env

settings = from_env({}, demo=True)
wanted = {"plaud_sync", "plaud_arrivals", "status"}
with TestClient(create_app(settings), base_url="http://localhost") as client:
    with client.websocket_connect(
        "ws://localhost/websocket/", headers={"Origin": "http://localhost"}
    ) as ws:
        hidden = {f".clientdata_output_{name}_hidden": False for name in wanted}
        ws.send_text(json.dumps({"method": "init", "data": hidden}))
        seen = set()

        def read():
            while not wanted <= seen:
                seen.update(json.loads(ws.receive_text()).get("values", {}))

        reader = threading.Thread(target=read, daemon=True)
        reader.start()
        reader.join(20)
    assert runtime.tagging().store.wait_open(30) == (True, None)
loaded = [m for m in ("recordings.worker", "recordings.plaud.client", "recordings.plaud.tokens")
          if m in sys.modules]
from recordings.state import State
beat = State.read_only(settings.archive.parent / "state").meta("worker_heartbeat")
print(json.dumps({"seen": sorted(seen), "loaded": loaded, "heartbeat": beat}))
""",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    out = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(probe)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=90
    )
    found = json.loads(out.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    assert found == {
        "seen": ["plaud_arrivals", "plaud_sync", "status"],
        "loaded": [],
        "heartbeat": None,
    }
```

# What the Pages demo must never load (§15.5): the Plaud client, the token store, the sync, and
# sqlite3, which Pyodide lacks. Phase 2 adds tokens, sync and sources/plaud; a test of a module
# that doesn't exist yet passes trivially, and starts to count the day it does.
NEVER_ON_PAGES = (
    "recordings.plaud.client",
    "recordings.plaud.tokens",
    "recordings.plaud.sync",
    "recordings.sources.plaud",
    "sqlite3",
)
PROBE = """
import json, runpy, sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime

app = sys.argv[1]
sys.path.insert(0, app)  # the vendored packages, never the installed ones
import recordings_ui.tagging as tagging

tagging.under_pyodide = lambda: True  # pages_store runs only under Pyodide
runpy.run_path(f"{app}/app.py", run_name="pages_app")
import recordings, recordings_ui
from recordings_ui import plaud, runtime

now = datetime.now(UTC)
views = runtime.plaud_settings()
sync = plaud.sync_view(views, now=now, can_request=runtime.plaud_reason())
plaud.sync_panel(views, now=now)
plaud.arrivals(views, since=now, now=now)
print(json.dumps({
    "vendored": [m.__file__.startswith(app) for m in (recordings, recordings_ui)],
    "rows": len(sync["not_here"]),
    "loaded": sorted(m for m in json.loads(sys.argv[2]) if m in sys.modules),
}))
"""


def test_the_canned_view_is_vendored(build_pages, tmp_path):
    # Decision 23: beside the vendored demo/archive, where from_env(demo=True) finds it.
    app = tmp_path / "app"
    app.mkdir()
    build_pages.assemble(app, build_pages.demo_media(), ui=_built_ui(tmp_path))
    vendored = app / "demo" / "plaud-sync.json"
    assert vendored.read_bytes() == (REPO / "demo" / "plaud-sync.json").read_bytes()


def test_it_refuses_to_run_without_the_canned_view(build_pages, tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "ui.js").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "ui.css").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit, match=r"plaud-sync\.json is missing"):
        build_pages.check_inputs(www=tmp_path, view=tmp_path / "plaud-sync.json")


def test_pyodide_never_imports_the_client_the_token_store_or_the_sync(build_pages, tmp_path):
    # why: §15.5. Pyodide runs the vendored app from pages/app.py: from that entry, through every
    # Plaud view it draws, nothing may load what reads Plaud or state.db.
    app = tmp_path / "app"
    app.mkdir()
    build_pages.assemble(app, build_pages.demo_media(), ui=_built_ui(tmp_path))
    probe = tmp_path / "probe.py"
    probe.write_text(PROBE, encoding="utf-8")
    out = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-I", str(probe), str(app), json.dumps(NEVER_ON_PAGES)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
        cwd=tmp_path,
        timeout=60,
    )
    found = json.loads(out.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    assert found == {"vendored": [True, True], "rows": 3, "loaded": []}

### Task 25: Phase end

From `phase-end.md`, the large-project version. Each step ends with its commit (`docs(plan): 🤖 phase end step K: <what it did>`, its trailer `Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-23-stage-2b-phase-1.md Phase end`), which ticks its box and sets **Now** to the next step.

- [ ] **1. The final whole-branch review:** Matt Pocock's two-axis `code-review` from `git merge-base main HEAD`; superpowers' one fix dispatch and one scoped re-review; a ruling on whatever is left. Each fix is its own commit.
- [ ] **2. The rest of the ledger copied into the plan:** whatever `.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-23-stage-2b-phase-1/progress.md` holds that no closing commit carries, under the task it belongs to.
- [ ] **3. The phase-end council:** four read-only reviewers (goal fit and scenarios, reliability, security, simplicity) on the whole branch; their reports committed first, in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-23-stage-2b-phase-1-end-council.md`; each claim checked against the code before Dan sees it; each finding given a severity and a decision. The security reviewer re-checks every task's tier.
- [ ] **4. The phase-end list worked through:** each item fixed in its own commit at the tier of what it touches, or moved to the spec's Later with a reason; missing docs written now.
- [ ] **5. The forward look:** the Phase 2 and Phase 3 outlines below rewritten to fit what was built (every Consumes line they will need, by its built name).
- [ ] **6. The retro:** `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-23-stage-2b-phase-1-retro.md`: departures, items carried forward, metrics per tier (from the closing commits' `Tier:`, `Rounds:` and `Findings:` lines), starting over; the retuning rules applied to Phase 2's tiers.
- [ ] **7. A dated `CHANGELOG.md` entry** (the file is created here), and the spec's status line set to `PR open (#N)` once step 8 opens it.
- [ ] **8. The PR:** title `chore(repo): 🤖 merge Phase 1: stage 2b's groundwork`; the body summarises each task, the council's findings and what became of them, the retro's link, and every file a scan can't read (`git log --format= --numstat origin/main..HEAD | awk '$1 == "-" { print "not scanned, check by eye: " $3 }'`), ending `Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-23-stage-2b-phase-1.md Phase end`. This repo has no `leakcheck.py`, `.githooks/` or denylist, so the PR text is scanned by `gitleaks stdin --redact --no-banner` alone: with the title and body in `.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-23-stage-2b-phase-1/PR_TITLE` and `PR_BODY.md`, `cat` both into `gitleaks stdin --redact --no-banner`, and only if it passes `gh pr create --base main --head stage-2b --title "$(cat …/PR_TITLE)" --body-file …/PR_BODY.md`; a finding stops everything, and Dan is told its kind and where, never the matched text. Never `--admin`, `--delete-branch`, squash or rebase.
- [ ] **9. [Dan] The merge** (attended: Dan merges the PR on GitHub). Then the Pages site serves the new demo (`pages.yml`); the status line's `merged` entry comes with Phase 2's start.
- [ ] **10. [Dan, optional] Deploy Phase 1** (runbook section 6, on the server). What it gains: late consent listings act on the real archive within seconds of the deploy, before the dry run (a consent-listed recording already here is tagged `private` and flagged); the auto-private marker runs whenever a recording is reconciled (a `recordings reindex`, or the next import), and Keep it here answers the flags those raise. Otherwise the worker stays idle, the sync's check stays unpinged (it never goes down until its first ping), and doctor says "sign-in needed" until Phase 2. Not deploying changes nothing for Phase 2.

## Phase 2 and Phase 3 outlines

Their full plans are written at their phase start, against the code as built and the spikes' results. Decision 44 moved some of Phase 1's first draft here; that code and its tests are in this plan at `0b3cefe` (Tasks 6, 12, 14, 19, 20), to reuse or rewrite against the spikes. The UI's contract for the data these phases write is `packages/ui/frontend/src/types.ts` and `demo/plaud-sync.json` as Phase 1 leaves them.
